description:
# Builders Day

Builders Day by [HackUnion](https://hackunion.in) is the culmination of the [OpenBuild Week](https://hackunion.in/obw) journey, a space where builders come together to collaborate, solve problems, build products, and compete.

From learning to building.
From ideas to prototypes.
From campus communities to one Builders Day.

**This is where builders come to build.**

## Before You Join

Builders Day is not about starting your project from scratch on the final day.

Projects can be developed from **28 July to 26 September**, with the final submission deadline at **3:00 PM IST on 26 September**.

Whether you're bringing an MVP from the OBW Campus Series or building independently, come prepared with a working product. We recommend having your project **~95% complete before Builders Day**.

Use the final day to **improve, test, scale, polish, network, showcase your work, and celebrate what you've built.**

Your project will be evaluated on:

* **Accessibility**
* **Working Product**
* **Purpose & Scalability**
* **Pitching**

### Read the Hackathon Guide Before You Start

We've put together the **Builders Day Participant Guide** with everything you need to know — eligibility, project requirements, development timeline, judging criteria, submissions, AI and tool usage, team participation, prizes, final-day expectations, and the submission checklist.

**📖 Read the complete Hackathon Guide → [HACKATHON GUIDE LINK](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E94z4u54nHiUxBpw96l-DLpnb-3EEDcx/view?usp=sharing)**

**Read it. Prepare your project. Then come ready to build.**

## Builders Day

**26 September 2026**

**Build it. Ship it. Show what it can become.**
